## Context / Problem
Two whole-tree AST scans duplicate what ruff's `flake8-tidy-imports` expresses natively and runs on every `make lint` and pre-commit: `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py::test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` (`:57-76`, bug a371: no `tests.`-rooted import anywhere under `tests/`) and `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py::test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope` (`:131-148`: no module-scope heavy import under `src/rebar` except `_engine`). The other import scans in table (5) cannot be expressed and STAY: TID251 and TID253 are each ONE global list toggled per path, so at most one scoped rule per code exists, and the remaining scans need an order/derivation condition, a file-scoped ban with positive presence, a reducer-only scope, and vendor allowlists. Current `[tool.ruff.lint]` (`pyproject.toml:437-495`) selects no TID codes; `ignore` must stay the RUF trio with no `extend-ignore` (`tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py:76-107`), so TID goes in `select` + `per-file-ignores` only. Ruff is `ruff==0.16.3` (`pyproject.toml:257`; the rules were verified on the venv's 0.16.2, and both are green on the current tree with `--config` overrides). Table (5) and the exact TOML are itemised in this ticket's first comment. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0; re-checked on c0cf1022671: `pyproject.toml` is unchanged since, both rules are green with the TOML below as `--config` overrides on ruff 0.16.3, and the two scans and their helpers are where cited.

## Approach
- `pyproject.toml`: add `"TID251"` and `"TID253"` to `select` (`:462-486`); add the `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]` table with `banned-module-level-imports = ["langchain","langgraph","langchain_anthropic","langchain_openai","langchain_mcp_adapters","langfuse","anthropic","deepagents","opentelemetry","pydantic_ai","httpx","tree_sitter","tree_sitter_language_pack","hcl2","lark"]` and the `[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports.banned-api]` sub-table with `"tests".msg = "tests.-rooted imports resolve only with the repo root on sys.path, which the bare pytest console script (make test, CI) does not provide; import same-directory helpers by bare name (bug a371)"`; per-file-ignores: add `"src/rebar/_engine/**" = ["TID253"]`, extend `:536` to `"tests/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]` and `:578` to `"scripts/**" = ["T201", "TID253"]`. TID251 parent matching covers `import tests.x`, `from tests import x`, `from tests.x import y`, and in-function imports.
- The per-file-ignore path `src/rebar/_engine/**` becomes `src/rebar/reconciler/**` if the reconciler epic (friended-brainsick-degus) lands its package move first; whichever change lands second updates the path.
- `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py`: delete `test_no_tests_rooted_imports_anywhere_under_tests` and `_tests_rooted_imports` (+ the then-unused `_tree_scan` import); keep `test_audit_page_modules_collect_under_bare_pytest` (the bug a371 repro).
- `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`: delete `test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope`, `_module_scope_imports`, `_is_heavy`; make `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` read the banned list from `pyproject.toml` via `tomllib` so the list has one source.
- `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` (`_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT`, now at `:739` after S2): set it to 9 (one `test_core_optionality.py` test fewer; S2 lands first and leaves it at 10).
- Every scan table (5) marks STAYS is untouched: `tests/unit/test_no_reducer_engine_support_cycle.py`, `tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_executor_tripwire.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dependency_direction.py`, and the reconciler ADF allowlist scans in `test_backend_neutrality.py`, `test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py`, `test_rich_text_seam.py` (S1 renamed it from `test_rich_text_seam_heldout.py`).

## Scope
In scope: `pyproject.toml`, `tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py`, `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`. Out of scope: every STAYS scan in table (5), `ignore` and `extend-ignore` in `[tool.ruff.lint]`, any RUF per-file entry, and every file under `src/` and `scripts/`.

## Testing
RED proof, run and its three transcripts recorded on this ticket: `printf 'from tests.unit.nothing import x\n' > tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py && ruff check tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py` → one `TID251 \`tests\` is banned`; `printf 'import httpx\n' > src/rebar/_e10_red.py && ruff check src/rebar/_e10_red.py` → one `TID253 \`httpx\` is banned at the module level`; `printf 'def f():\n    import httpx\n    return httpx\n' > src/rebar/_e10_red.py && ruff check src/rebar/_e10_red.py` → clean; remove both scratch files. Then `make lint` green on the real tree; `make test` green; `pytest --collect-only -q tests/unit/test_tests_import_convention.py tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py` shows exactly 2 fewer nodes than before.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `ruff check --select TID251,TID253 src tests scripts` exits 0.
- [ ] The three RED-proof transcripts (TID251 fires, TID253 fires at module level, TID253 silent for the in-function import) are on this ticket as a comment, and `tests/unit/test_e10_red_tid251.py` and `src/rebar/_e10_red.py` are absent from the tree.
- [ ] `tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py` passes (`ignore` untouched, no RUF per-file entry).
- [ ] `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` reads its banned list from `pyproject.toml` (verified by `git grep -n tomllib tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`).
- [ ] The two scan tests and their helpers collect nothing: `pytest --collect-only -q` on the two modules shows exactly 2 fewer nodes, and `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT == 9` keeps `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` green.
- [ ] `make verify` green apart from the 17 arm64-host pandoc failures tracked in frenzied-snively-llama.
